objective: Reissue TRIPLE-PRODUCT-20261026-001C-P001 with the review's corrections: Moussard 2017 as precursor and novelty downgraded; Habiro Props. 3.3-3.4 with disk framing and Seifert-framing preservation; the trivial cover over the Y-graph's neighbourhood and existence of extensions; basing paths; the leaf-product convention; the interpretation of realizable forms labelled; the typo fixed. Same checks.
status: Proved by CORRECTIONS-20261026-001C-P001 (reissue of TRIPLE-PRODUCT-20261026-001C-P001 after the independent review): Y-surgery with leaves in ker psi keeps H1 and V and changes the twisted triple product by the determinant of the leaf functionals (Massuyeau's Lemma 3.2 lifted to the 3-fold cover; Moussard 2017 is the rational precursor); the reachable forms are T0 plus all alternating forms; on knot surgeries with a disk-framed trivial leaf the moves are Borromean insertions preserving the Seifert framing. Checks rerun.
title: Borromean insertions steer the twisted triple product (reissued)
